concerns.text: FR-005 in spec mandates a plain Bonferroni correction, but T007r implements a Holm‑Bonferroni correction without any spec amendment, weakening the functional requirement.

Spec and assumptions describe modeling of multiple properties (solubility, logP, boiling point). All Phase 1 tasks (T001‑T004) operate solely on logP from ESOL, silently narrowing the study scope and violating FR‑005/SC‑003 which depend on N > 1.

SC‑003 requires measuring the family‑wise error rate (FWER) against the nominal α = 0.05. T007r only outputs corrected p‑values and does not provide any FWER measurement, dropping an acceptance criterion.
Data‑model contract defines field `bonferroni_adjusted_p` for corrected p‑values, but T007r writes `corrected_pvalues` under a different JSON key, breaking the read‑only schema contract.

Data‑model specifies diagnostics files at `reports/diagnostics/vif_report.json` and `mi_report.json`, yet T008r writes a combined `reports/metrics/diagnostics.json`, violating the storage schema contract.
